Outcome and e7 citation fields match.

The operator's distraction (the probable cause) is disclosed in e2's explanation and in the limitations. The non-LLM scope and the June 2020 corrected-report date are also disclosed. The rationale says 'establishes' where e1 calls the below-superintelligence point an evaluator inference. That point is trivially true, so I didn't count it.
